privacy.title: Privacy.
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data matters to us – all the more so for a service that deals with personal matters. This page explains which data this website processes.

sections.title: Controller
body: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is the provider named in the legal notice.

sections.title: Visiting this website
body: When you visit this website, the hosting provider processes technically necessary data – such as IP address, time of the request, page requested and browser type – in order to deliver the page and keep it secure. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.title: No cookies, no advertising
body: This website sets no cookies and integrates no advertising services. To measure reach we use Vercel Web Analytics: the service works without cookies and records page views only in aggregated form – such as the page viewed, the referring page, country and device type. Individual visitors are not identified. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Fonts are served from our own server.

sections.title: Registering your interest and contacting us
body: When you register your interest through the form, we process the details you provide – name, email address, your selection and an optional message – solely to contact you about Project L.E.B.E.N. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR.
You may withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future. Your details will then be deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection (Art. 15 to 21 GDPR). You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

sections.title: Using Lisa
body: Separate privacy information applies to conversations with Lisa and to personal memory. We will publish it here before the service launches.
